quest.title: A Small Token
quest.description: Go to the Masters of the Night-Wind, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Citlali...

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Citlali's home to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Is the tea to your liking? Or would you prefer something with a little more bite?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Tea is fine. I feel guilty drinking during the day. Best not to do it too often...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Anyway, Miss Guillotin, what brings you to Natlan?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'm just traveling around, visiting old acquaintances. Besides, I wanted to thank you for agreeing to help out during the Fontinalia Festival.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: You're too polite. Did you really come all the way here just for that?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Well... Although you were gracious enough not to bring it up last time, I'm well aware I've caused you trouble in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Ah... That business with your subordinate? The incident involving the robot, Ineffa...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Heh... Isn't life strange? You might suddenly find yourself friends with your former enemy's boss... You might even find they become your own boss...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I hope you can accept this as a small token of apology.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Th—This... It's a limited edition... No, a collector's edition!? And it's my favorite genre!? H—How did you know...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: #I asked {NICKNAME} for advice. {M#He}{F#She} has a pretty good grasp of your reading preferences.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}...!?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: (Ugh...! What's with these conflicting feelings!? It's like I'm pleased but also embarrassed.)

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: #(Naturally, I'm flattered {M#he}{F#she} knows what I like, but does {M#he}{F#she} really have to go shouting it from the rooftops? I'd rather {M#he}{F#she} just gave me a gift {M#himself}{F#herself}!)

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Do you like it?

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Ah... Th—Thank you! You're too kind, Miss Guillotin.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: #If it's the type you like, then next time, I can bring you some more. Of course, when the time comes, I'll have to trouble {NICKNAME} to pick them out with me.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: ...W—With you!? You mean... You went to the bookstore together to get this!?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: #Yes. {M#He}{F#She} seemed intent on choosing the perfect one. Maybe next time...

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: ...There'd better not be a next time!!!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Oh... I... Uhm...

talks.objective: Head for the vicinity of Citlali's home to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: #Ugh... Just wait till I get my hands on {M#him}{F#her}!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Is that the time? Alright, Miss Guillotin, be careful on the road.
